## Non-linear lung digital twin

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%"}

![](Schemes/lung_pressure_zoomed.svg){width=40% fig-align="center"}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Pi = & \int_{\Omega_0} \Psi_{\text{SVK}}\left(\matrice{E}\right) \mathrm{d}V - \int_{\Omega_0} \vect{f}\left(\theta, \phi\right) \cdot \vect{u} \, \mathrm{d}V \\
& + \frac{1}{2}\int_{\partial \Omega_0} k_b \left( \vect{u}\cdot \vect{N} \right)^2 \mathrm{d}S - W_p
\end{aligned}
$$

* Follower pressure on the deformed surface
  * $\delta W_p = \int_{\partial \Omega_t} p \, \vect{n} \cdot \delta \vect{u} \, \mathrm{d}a$
  * $p = p_0 + H\left(z-z_0 \right) + K\left(y-y_0 \right)$

:::: {.mybox}

::: {.mybox-header}
6 parameters
:::

::: {.mybox-body}
* $E$, $\left(\theta, \phi\right)$, $\left(p_0, H, K\right)$
* **No linearisation by hand** (autodiff)
